Description: Register byte address offset within AES address space
Start pulse initiating AES encryption or decryption (auto-clearing)
Soft reset command re-initializing internal round registers
Interrupt enable on completion of cryptographic operation
Busy flag: 1 = Transformation in progress (10-11 cycles)
Done flag: 1 = Operation finished (cleared on next start)
Valid flag: 1 = Valid result available in DOUT registers
128-bit input block registers (Plaintext for Enc / Ciphertext for Dec)
128-bit output result registers (Ciphertext for Enc / Plaintext for Dec)
Direct hardware interrupt output asserted on DONE when IRQ_EN is set
